hardware_details: Shared Apple M3 Max, 48 GiB RAM, 16 CPU cores. Initial queue: four hosted evaluations. Three stopped OpenAI models continue only missing scenarios; three not-yet-started Claude models move to a disjoint queue, for at most ten concurrent hosted evaluations. A serial reference-policy cohort runs on the same machine. CLI startup and reconnection overhead are included per decision. These are throughput exhibitions, not isolated latency microbenchmarks. Sonnet 5.5 resumes after a transient game-worker failure during replay, raising the temporary upper bound to eleven hosted evaluations; its original Luanti episode passed unchanged on reverification.

integration_coverage.purpose: New task admission; model standings remain the original v0.2 cohort.
